user.title: Connect Home Comfort
user.description:
Choose how Home Assistant connects to your system.

**Cloud access** signs in to your account. It offers controls, time programs, holidays and system information.

**Local access** connects to the gateway in your home network. It only reads: no controls and no settings. It updates many readings more often and can add technical readings the cloud does not offer, such as the refrigerant circuit, pumps and internal signals.

Each access has readings the other does not have. If both are possible, **cloud and local access** is recommended.

cloud.title: Connect a heating account
cloud.description: Choose the brand of the mobile app that is already linked to the heating system. Select **Bosch** for the Bosch app or **Buderus** for the Buderus app. The app brand matters more than the logo on the appliance.

auth.title: Sign in with SingleKey ID
auth.description:
SingleKey ID is the same sign-in used by your Bosch or Buderus app. Use the same email address or mobile number and password. You do not need a new account, and you do **not** enter your password in Home Assistant.

1. Keep this dialog open and open [SingleKey ID]({authorization_url}) in a new Chrome tab. Always use this newly generated link.
2. Press `F12` there and open **Console** in the developer tools.
3. Sign in with the SingleKey ID credentials used by your heating app.
4. A network-problem message may appear after sign-in. In this case it normally only means that Chrome could not open the `{redirect_scheme}://` app address.
5. Find the red **Failed to launch** or **Connecting to** message in the console. Right-click the blue `{redirect_scheme}://` address in that message and choose **Copy link address**.
6. Return to this dialog, paste the complete address below, and select **OK**. The field may display dots for security.

Use the address from this exact sign-in attempt and do not copy only the `code` parameter. The complete address contains a short-lived one-time code. Never share it in an issue, chat, screenshot, or log.

auth_wait.title: Wait before signing in again
auth_wait.description: SingleKey ID is temporarily limiting sign-in requests. Wait at least another {seconds} seconds, then select **Submit**. The next step will provide a new sign-in link.

retry.title: Retry gateway discovery
retry.description: Sign-in succeeded, but the device list could not be loaded. Check the Home Assistant internet connection, wait a moment, and try again.

selection_expired.title: Load the device list again
selection_expired.description: The device list is older than five minutes and has to be loaded again before saving. You stay signed in. Select **Submit** to load the list again, then choose the devices.

gateways.title: Select devices
gateways.description: Select the gateways and additional devices that Home Assistant should use. The final characters help distinguish devices. Available readings and controls depend on the model and the capabilities reported by the device.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The saved authorization is no longer valid. Repeat SingleKey ID sign-in. Your existing device selection will be kept.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure and rediscover
reconfigure.description: Choose the app brand, gateways, and polling profile. Saving reloads the integration and performs a complete resource discovery. Use this after a firmware update or when circuits, hot water systems, heat sources, or gateways have changed. **Standard** reads current operating values every minute. **Cloud-friendly** reduces cloud traffic by reading them every two minutes and all other changing values less often. Changing the app brand requires a new SingleKey ID sign-in.

reconfigure_retry.title: Retry gateway discovery
reconfigure_retry.description: The current gateway list could not be loaded. Check the Home Assistant internet connection, wait a moment, and select **Submit**.

local_owner.title: Choose the existing setup
local_owner.description: Select the setup this local gateway belongs to. This will not create another installation.

local_target.title: Choose the installation
local_target.description: Select the installation to connect locally. Its gateway identity will be checked before saving.

local_address.title: Local gateway address
local_address.description: Choose a discovered address or enter an IP address or hostname. Discovery does not change any saved connection.

local_method.title: Connect to the local gateway
local_method.description: Sign in with the device label or use an existing access token. Local appliance access is read-only.

local_method_keep.title: Connect to the local gateway again
local_method_keep.description:
A new sign-in with the **device label** is recommended.

Keep the current token only if you are sure that the certificate you are about to confirm belongs to your own gateway, for example right after an update or reset you started yourself. With this option, the stored token is sent to the device that presents the newly confirmed certificate. If that is not your gateway, it receives a working token for your system. Signing in with the device label is safer: the label details only work together with the buttons on the gateway, while a stored token works right away for anyone who receives it.

Local appliance access is read-only.

local_certificate.title: Confirm the gateway certificate
local_certificate.description:
Home Assistant reached **{host}:{port}**. Confirm that this is your gateway before sending credentials. A fingerprint is not proof of identity on its own.

SHA-256: `{fingerprint}`

Previous fingerprint: `{previous}`. A question mark means no saved certificate applies to this address and port.

data.confirm: I confirm this gateway and its certificate

local_auth.title: Sign in with the device label
local_auth.description: Enter the Login and Pass from the gateway label. To release local sign-in, press the Wi-Fi and wireless buttons together for about two seconds, under three seconds, and release them together. Confirm the brief blue signal and continue within five minutes. Access stays on your selected LAN address. The gateway response determines whether sign-in was released. Login and password are not saved.

data.unlocked: I have released local sign-in and seen the blue signal

local_token.title: Use an existing token
local_token.description: Enter a local API access token. It will be retained privately so this setup can be resumed. The data connection and gateway identity still need to be checked.

local_pending.title: Resume local setup
local_pending.description:
A previous attempt is saved. If a token was received, continue with that token. If the response was lost, a token may exist on the gateway even though Home Assistant could not save it. Discarding removes only the local pending copy and permits another attempt; it does not revoke gateway tokens.

Remaining server pause: {seconds} seconds.

data.confirm: I understand and want to discard this pending attempt

local_result.title: Confirm the local connection
local_result.description: The read check for **{host}** succeeded and gateway **{gateway}** matches the selected installation. Saving checks the current data again and adds or updates this access on the existing setup.

local_retry.title: Local check could not finish
local_retry.description: Check the message below and try again when ready. No token is automatically created or replaced.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Heating system faults appear under the bell in Home Assistant. For multiple installations, select those you want notifications for. Notifications and dismissals are shared by all users. Their text uses the system language. Dismissing a notification does not acknowledge a fault on the appliance. New or more critical faults appear again. Changes take effect immediately.

holidays.title: Manage holiday periods
holidays.description: Create a holiday or select an existing one to change its name, dates and heating settings, or delete it. The Holiday periods calendar remains available too.

delete_holiday.title: Delete holiday
delete_holiday.description:
**{holiday}**

Delete this holiday completely? It will also be removed from the heating system and the calendar. Leave the confirmation unchecked to return without deleting.

holiday.title: Holiday period
holiday.description: Set the name, period and settings. Choose quarter-hour times: minutes 00, 15, 30 or 45. Normal operation resumes at the end.

holiday_gateway.title: Choose installation
holiday_gateway.description: Choose the installation for the new holiday.

new_holiday.title: Holiday period
new_holiday.description: Set the name, period and settings. Choose quarter-hour times: minutes 00, 15, 30 or 45. Normal operation resumes at the end.

legacy_holiday.title: Holiday period
legacy_holiday.description: Adjust **{holiday}**. This device stores whole holiday days. The end date is the first day after the holiday. Times and custom names are not supported. Only settings and free holiday slots reported by the device are offered.

new_legacy_holiday.title: Holiday period
new_legacy_holiday.description: Choose the dates and settings. This device stores whole holiday days. The end date is the first day after the holiday. Times and custom names are not supported. Only settings and free holiday slots reported by the device are offered.

holiday_mode.title: Configure holiday
holiday_mode.description: This device provides a holiday mode that can be switched on and off. It does not store holiday periods.

rrc_programs.title: Select heating schedule
rrc_programs.description: Choose an existing weekly schedule. It may be shared by several zones.

rrc_schedule.title: View heating schedule

rrc_readonly.title: View heating schedule

rrc_point.title: Edit switch point
rrc_point.description:
**{program}**

Choose a time in five-minute steps and a temperature from 5 to 30 °C in 0.5 °C steps. The time repeats weekly in the heating system's local time. Changes affect all assigned zones.

operate.title: Operate appliance
operate.description: Choose a section and adjust the settings. Apply writes only your changes. When changing several settings, each is confirmed individually.

connections.title: Connections
connections.description: Choose the access you want to manage.

menu_options.local_values: Use local values for existing entities

connection_enabled.title: Enable access
connection_enabled.description: Disabling affects only this access. Other connections continue running. Systems and entities are retained.

connection_forget.title: Forget deselected systems
connection_forget.description: These systems are switched off for this access. Forgotten systems are no longer listed here and a new sign-in no longer needs to find them. Their devices and entities stay in Home Assistant until you delete them. If the gateway was exchanged, keep the system switched on instead: a repair note then offers to continue it with its history.

connection_targets.title: Systems and devices
connection_targets.description: Choose the targets that should use this access. Other targets continue using their connections independently.

connection_remove_cloud.title: Remove cloud access
connection_remove_cloud.description: The sign-in will be removed. Selected systems with an enabled local access keep showing their local readings (read-only, no controls; counters continue from the last shown value). Other systems keep their entities without current values. If you sign in again later, the same entities continue. For a temporary pause, switch the access off instead.

connection_remove.title: Remove access
connection_remove.description: The credentials will be removed. Systems and entities are retained, even if this is the last access. Without an available connection, entities cannot show current values.

connection_polling.title: Polling frequency
connection_polling.description: Standard reads current heating operating values every minute, settings and energy values every 5 minutes and slower information every 15 minutes. Cloud-friendly doubles these intervals. Active faults are checked every minute in both profiles. The profile applies to PointT heating and wallbox polling of the selected cloud connection; additional cloud devices report changes as messages. Sign-in, device checks and the confirmation after a change can add requests outside this schedule. If a polling cycle takes longer than its interval, the next one starts later.

connection_add_cloud.title: Connect cloud access
connection_add_cloud.description: Choose the app brand you use. After signing in, select the systems and devices to connect to this entry. Existing systems and entities are retained.

cloud_retry.description: Retry when the cloud is available again. Your entry has not been changed.

cloud_select.title: Select systems and devices
cloud_select.description: Select the systems and devices to connect. A matching existing system keeps its entities and settings.

connection_discover.title: Search and select devices
connection_discover.description: Select the systems and devices to use through this cloud connection. Previously configured devices remain listed even when temporarily unavailable. Deselecting stops their queries and keeps their entities.

connection_discover_retry.title: Retry device discovery
connection_discover_retry.description: The selection has not been changed. Retry to load a fresh list.

local_polling.title: Local polling
local_polling.description: Confirmed resources: {known}. Currently available: {available}. These counts show the state when this dialog was opened. The interval is the target for live values. Settings, energy values and diagnostics are read every 5 minutes and counters every 15 minutes, or at this interval if it is longer; static details are read daily. A value becomes unavailable after three missed intervals. Large resource sets can take longer. Cloud polling remains independent. Readings that the cloud also provides are read locally at least as often as in the cloud.

local_values.title: Local values for existing entities
local_values.description:
While the cloud is running, this option decides whether existing sensors use the local value of a reading that both accesses provide under the same documented resource. Without the cloud (switched off, sign-in required, paused, limited or unreachable), local values are always used. The option is on by default for new setups with cloud and local access.

When enabled, the local value is used as long as it is current. If the local value is outdated or missing, the current cloud value is used; if both are outdated, the sensor becomes unavailable. Energy, start and operating-time counters use the local value too, but only change their source when every shown count is at least the last shown count, so a source change never makes them count backwards. Adjustable settings keep using the cloud. Entity IDs, names and history stay unchanged. Controls and changes are still sent through the cloud.

rescan.title: Search the system again
rescan.description: Searches the system once more for parts and readings, through the cloud access and the local access. Use it after adding or changing components. The search runs with the next regular update and within the usual limits for requests; it never removes an entity, and readings it does not find again stay as they are.

error.no_gateways: No devices were found. Check that the selected brand and SingleKey ID account match your app. A room controller with older firmware only appears once its firmware has been updated and it has been set up in the current app with your SingleKey ID.
error.local_invalid_address: Enter an IP address or hostname without a URL, path or credentials.
error.local_interface_required: This IPv6 address needs the network interface on the Home Assistant host.
error.local_invalid_token: The token format is invalid. Copy the complete token without spaces.
error.local_invalid_credentials: Check Login and Pass on the gateway label and enter them again.
error.local_unlock_required: Release local sign-in on the gateway and confirm the blue signal before trying again.
error.local_token_database_full: The gateway token database is full. Review its existing tokens before creating another. No tokens were deleted.
error.local_rate_limited: The gateway requested a pause. Wait until the displayed time has elapsed.
error.local_service_unavailable: The gateway service is temporarily unavailable. Wait and try again.
error.local_timeout: The local gateway did not respond in time. Check the connection and try again.
error.local_connection_failed: Home Assistant could not reach this gateway. Check its address and the network connection.
error.local_certificate_changed: The certificate could not be confirmed or has changed. Inspect the gateway certificate again before continuing.
error.local_token_rejected: The gateway rejected this token. Check it or deliberately discard this attempt to use another.
error.local_resource_forbidden: The gateway denied access to a required resource. A token alone does not prove read access.
error.local_missing_resource: The gateway does not provide a required setup resource.
error.local_unknown_firmware: The firmware version could not be verified.
error.local_old_firmware: Update the gateway firmware before setting up the local connection.
error.local_unsupported_brand: This gateway brand is not supported by the documented local interface.
error.local_incomplete_system: The gateway system information is not complete yet. Try the read check again later.
error.local_invalid_response: A required gateway response could not be verified.
error.local_identity_unverified: This system has not yet been matched unambiguously. The first setup requires an available cloud access and matching gateway and module identifiers from both interfaces. Verified links can subsequently be used without the cloud.
error.local_identity_conflict: The gateway identity conflicts with the selected installation or another setup.
error.local_configuration_changed: The selected connection or installation changed. Close this dialog and review the current setup before continuing.
error.local_pending_exists: Another pending attempt exists for this installation or gateway address. Resume or deliberately discard it first.
error.local_storage_failed: The private setup record could not be read or saved. Check Home Assistant storage before continuing.
error.local_completion_uncertain: The connection may already have been saved. Reopen local setup to check its state before attempting another change.
error.local_unexpected: The local check could not be completed. The pending token, if received, is retained for recovery.
error.local_confirmation_required: Confirm this action explicitly before continuing.
error.local_busy: Local access is currently busy or paused. Wait before trying again.
error.local_invalid_interval: Choose 60 to 900 seconds in steps of 60 seconds.
error.local_cloud_auth_required: Sign in to the cloud access again so the first link can be verified. An already verified local access starts independently of the cloud.
error.local_cloud_rate_limited: The cloud is currently limiting requests. Wait for its pause to end, then retry the identity comparison.
error.local_cloud_unavailable: The cloud system information could not be read. Check the cloud access and retry the identity comparison.
error.local_auth_forbidden: The gateway's sign-in service refused the request. Check that local access is allowed on the gateway, then try again.
error.local_creation_uncertain: It is unclear whether the gateway created a token, because its answer was incomplete. Continue with the pending attempt; a new token is not created automatically.
error.cloud_local_first_other_entry: This system is already set up through its local access in another entry of this integration. Add the cloud access in that entry instead.
error.cloud_local_first_unverified: This system could not be compared with the cloud. Nothing was saved. Please try again.
error.cloud_local_first_local_unavailable: The local access of this system is switched off, not running, unreachable or paused. Switch it on and make sure it is reachable, or set it up again, then try again. Nothing was saved.
error.cloud_local_first_local_busy: The local access of this system is busy with its regular readings. Nothing was saved. Wait a moment and try again.
error.cloud_rate_limited_until: The cloud has requested a pause until {until}. Nothing was saved. Please try again after that.
error.cloud_local_first_conflict: The cloud and the local access do not describe the same system. Nothing was saved. Deselect this system to keep using it through its local access only.
error.local_plant_known: This gateway already belongs to a configured system. Choose that system instead of a new one.
error.auth_expired: This sign-in attempt has expired. Open the new SingleKey ID link shown above and sign in again.
error.auth_restart: This sign-in attempt can no longer be used. Open the new SingleKey ID link shown above and sign in again.

abort.notification_gateways_changed: The installation selection changed. Open the settings again.
abort.holiday_changed: The selected holiday has changed or is no longer available for editing. Open the holiday again to review its current details.
abort.holiday_updated: The holiday settings were saved and confirmed by the heating system.
abort.holiday_unchanged: Nothing was changed, so nothing was sent to the heating system.
abort.no_writable_holidays: Holiday management is currently unavailable. Wait until the installation has provided its holiday settings.
abort.holiday_deleted: The holiday was deleted and its removal was confirmed by the heating system.
abort.not_loaded: Bosch/Buderus Home Comfort must be loaded before a holiday can be configured.
abort.holiday_created: The holiday was created and confirmed by reading it back.
abort.holiday_previous_request_found: The earlier unresolved request is now confirmed. Your new inputs were not sent. Check the existing holiday under Manage holiday periods first.
abort.holiday_already_exists: A holiday with this start and circuit selection already exists. No additional holiday was created. Open Manage holiday periods and edit the existing entry.
abort.holiday_create_unconfirmed: The creation request could not be confirmed. The holiday may already exist. Check Manage holiday periods or the manufacturer app. For the next 10 minutes, another attempt checks the result of this request without creating a second holiday.
abort.holiday_create_adjusted: The heating system returned a new holiday, but its settings differ from your request. Requested period: {requested}. Returned period: {actual}. Open Manage holiday periods to check and edit this entry.
abort.holiday_update_adjusted: The heating system returned settings that differ from your requested change. Requested period: {requested}. Returned period: {actual}. Open Manage holiday periods to check and edit the current entry.
abort.no_rrc_schedules: No current, supported RRC weekly schedule is available.
abort.controls_not_loaded: Controls are only available through the cloud access; the local access only reads. Connect a cloud access or wait until it has loaded.
abort.controls_auth_required: Controls are not available: the cloud access needs a new sign-in. Readings stay visible.
abort.controls_cloud_stopped: Controls are not available: the cloud access is stopped or being restarted. Readings stay visible.
abort.controls_rate_limited: Controls are paused after a rate limit of the cloud until about {until}. Readings stay visible.
abort.controls_protection_pause: Controls are paused after repeated cloud errors until about {until}. Readings stay visible.
abort.controls_cloud_unreachable: Controls are not available: the cloud is not reachable right now. Readings stay visible.
abort.controls_not_current: Controls are not available yet: the cloud has not delivered current values. Try again in a moment.
abort.controls_none: This appliance currently reports no settings that can be changed here.
abort.configuration_changed: The connection settings changed while this dialog was open. Please close it and try again.
abort.no_connections: No access is configured. Existing systems and entities are retained.
abort.connection_reauth_started: Sign-in has been requested. Open the authentication prompt for this entry.
abort.cloud_already_connected: A cloud connection is already configured. Use its connection settings to select more devices or sign in again. A second parallel cloud sign-in is not supported yet.
abort.cloud_setup_in_progress: Another cloud setup is already open. Finish or close that dialog first.
abort.cloud_setup_taken_over: A newer cloud setup dialog has replaced this one. Close this dialog and continue in the newer one.
abort.cloud_target_owned: A selected system or device belongs to another configured entry or cloud connection. Reconnect it through its existing entry.
abort.cloud_selection_expired: This device list is no longer current. Open device discovery again before saving.
abort.cloud_selection_changed: The selected device is not in the confirmed list. Please search again.
abort.cloud_connection_disabled: Enable this cloud connection before searching for devices.
abort.cloud_rate_limited: The cloud has requested a pause. Please wait before trying again.
abort.local_setup_unavailable: Local setup is not available until regular local data supply is ready.
abort.local_session_changed: This setup session has ended or its selection changed. Reopen local setup to continue.
abort.local_discovery_invalid: This discovery announcement does not describe a supported local gateway endpoint.
abort.local_existing_owner_required: Set up a system without the cloud with "Local access only" when adding the integration. A discovered gateway can be added to an existing setup.
abort.local_target_required: This setup has no suitable retained installation for a local connection.
abort.local_setup_complete: The local access has been set up.
abort.local_pending_saved: The pending attempt is retained. You can resume it from local setup.
abort.local_storage_failed: The private setup record could not be read or saved. Check Home Assistant storage before continuing.
abort.cloud_local_first_other_entry: This system is already set up through its local access in another entry of this integration. Add the cloud access in that entry instead.
abort.rescan_planned: The search is planned and runs with the next regular update; new parts appear as soon as they are found.
abort.rescan_paused: The search was not started: requests are paused right now (for example after the cloud asked for a pause). Please try again later.
abort.rescan_running: A search is already running or planned. Please wait until it has finished.
abort.rescan_partial: The search is planned for the parts that are ready and runs with the next regular update. Parts that are paused right now were skipped; please try again later for them.
abort.rescan_unavailable: The search was not started: no access to the system is ready right now.

progress.local_work: Checking the local connection. Please wait.

fault_source_removed.title: A fault source no longer exists
fault_source_removed.description: The integration no longer waits for {count} fault source(s) of a heating system that no longer exist, for example the error list of a radio room device that was removed or replaced. Until now such a source kept every fault from ending. Faults that only it reported now end after the next two complete reads with a normal "resolved" event. If the device is still installed, check its connection to the system; its error list counts again as soon as the system reports it again. You can ignore this notice; it disappears after the next restart.

confirm.title: Use cloud-friendly polling
confirm.description: Select **Submit** to switch this integration to the cloud-friendly polling profile. Current operating values will then be read every two minutes instead of every minute; control and energy values every ten minutes; slow counters every thirty minutes. The integration reloads and performs a complete resource discovery.

abort.entry_not_found: The affected Bosch/Buderus Home Comfort entry no longer exists.

confirm.description: Bosch/Buderus Home Comfort found {conflict_count} known capabilities whose data type or unit no longer matches the safely supported PointT schema. Select **Submit** to reload the integration and inspect all capabilities again. If the warning returns, download the integration diagnostics and report the changed schema without sharing credentials or raw values.

abort.entry_not_found: The affected Bosch/Buderus Home Comfort entry no longer exists.

confirm.title: Use cloud-friendly polling
confirm.description: Switch only the affected cloud connection to cloud-friendly polling: current operating values every two minutes, control and energy values every ten minutes, and slow counters every thirty minutes. Only this connection reconnects; other connections remain active.

abort.entry_not_found: The affected Bosch/Buderus Home Comfort entry no longer exists.

confirm.description: This heating system reports {conflict_count} known capabilities with an unexpected data type or unit. Inspect its capabilities again. Only this source restarts; other systems and connections remain active. Existing entity IDs and custom settings are retained.

abort.entry_not_found: The affected Bosch/Buderus Home Comfort entry no longer exists.
abort.configuration_changed: The access or heating system has changed. Open the repair again.

local_certificate_changed.title: Local gateway certificate changed
local_certificate_changed.description: The gateway of a local access presents a different certificate. The integration does not accept it on its own and stops reading locally. If you know why the certificate changed (for example after a gateway update or reset), open the integration options, choose the local access and select "Change local access". You confirm the new certificate there. A new sign-in with the device label is recommended; keep the current token only if you are sure the new certificate belongs to your own gateway.

confirm.title: Try the local access again
confirm.description: The local access has failed to start several times in a row because the secure connection to the gateway could not be established (code: {code}). This can happen while the gateway restarts. The integration keeps trying on its own, at the latest every hour, and removes this note once the local access starts. Other accesses are not affected. Select **Submit** to try again now. If it persists, check that the stored address still belongs to your gateway.

abort.entry_not_found: The affected entry no longer exists.
abort.configuration_changed: The access or heating system has changed. Open the repair again.

local_start_incomplete.title: Local gateway is not ready yet

confirm.title: Try the local access again
confirm.description: The local access has failed to start several times in a row because the gateway reports that its system information is not complete yet (code: {code}). This is usual for a while after the gateway starts. The integration keeps trying on its own, at the latest every hour, and removes this note once the local access starts. Other accesses are not affected. Select **Submit** to try again now. If the note stays for hours, restart the gateway.

abort.entry_not_found: The affected entry no longer exists.
abort.configuration_changed: The access or heating system has changed. Open the repair again.

confirm.title: Try the local access again
confirm.description: The local access has failed to start several times in a row because the gateway's answer about its brand, firmware or identity could not be recognized (code: {code}). The integration keeps trying on its own, at the latest every hour, and removes this note once the local access starts. Other accesses are not affected. Select **Submit** to try again now. If the note stays after a gateway update, please report the code.

abort.entry_not_found: The affected entry no longer exists.
abort.configuration_changed: The access or heating system has changed. Open the repair again.

confirm.title: Try the local access again
confirm.description: The local access has failed to start several times in a row because the gateway answers, but not as expected, for example with an error or an unreadable answer (code: {code}). The integration keeps trying on its own, at the latest every hour, and removes this note once the local access starts. Other accesses are not affected. Select **Submit** to try again now. If it persists, check that the stored address still belongs to your gateway.

abort.entry_not_found: The affected entry no longer exists.
abort.configuration_changed: The access or heating system has changed. Open the repair again.

cloud_targets_not_found.title: Systems not found in the cloud account
cloud_targets_not_found.description:
The last sign-in of the cloud access in "{title}" did not find {count} switched-on systems or devices (ending in {systems}). They stay configured and unavailable until they appear in the account again; this note then disappears.

If they were removed from the account, open Configure → Connections → the cloud access, switch them off under **Use for systems and devices** and remove them with **Forget deselected systems**. Their devices and entities stay in Home Assistant until you delete them. If a gateway was exchanged, keep it switched on: a separate repair note offers to continue the system with its history.

evidence_match.title: Gateway replaced?
evidence_match.description:
The gateway ending in **{old}** no longer appears in the cloud access. A new gateway ending in **{new}** appeared instead. At least one device module it reports matches one this system reported before (for example the heat source or the controller). This strongly suggests that the gateway was replaced.

How do you want to continue?

evidence_no_match.title: Gateway replaced?
evidence_no_match.description:
The gateway ending in **{old}** no longer appears in the cloud access. A new gateway ending in **{new}** appeared instead. However, the device modules it reports differ from those this system reported before. It may belong to another system.

How do you want to continue?

evidence_unknown.title: Gateway replaced?
evidence_unknown.description:
The gateway ending in **{old}** no longer appears in the cloud access. A new gateway ending in **{new}** appeared instead. Its device modules could not be compared, because no earlier module data is stored or the new gateway did not report any. Whether it is the same system cannot be confirmed.

How do you want to continue?

continue_match.title: Continue as the same system
continue_match.description:
The system continues with the gateway ending in {new}. Its history, its entities with their IDs, names and areas, and your automations stay. The integration stops briefly and starts again.

If a local access is set up for this system, it is removed, because it belongs to the old gateway. Set it up again for the new gateway afterwards.

Please create a Home Assistant backup first.

data.confirm: Continue this system with the new gateway

continue_unverified.title: Continue without confirmation
continue_unverified.description:
**Warning:** It cannot be confirmed that the gateway ending in {new} belongs to this system. If it belongs to another system, that system's values end up in this system's history and your automations act on the wrong system. Only continue if you replaced the gateway yourself and are sure.

The system continues with the gateway ending in {new}. Its history, its entities with their IDs, names and areas, and your automations stay. The integration stops briefly and starts again.

If a local access is set up for this system, it is removed, because it belongs to the old gateway. Set it up again for the new gateway afterwards.

Please create a Home Assistant backup first.

data.confirm: Continue this system with the new gateway
data.confirm_unverified: I am sure that the new gateway belongs to this system

separate.title: Keep as a separate system
separate.description: The integration no longer asks about this gateway. The system with the old gateway stays as it is. To add the new gateway as a system of its own, select it in the options of the cloud access.

abort.entry_not_found: The affected entry of this integration no longer exists.
abort.configuration_changed: The access or the system has changed. Open the repair again.
abort.later: Nothing was changed. The note stays under repairs until you decide.
abort.exchange_unavailable: The integration is not running. Start it and open the repair again.
abort.cloud_unavailable: The cloud access cannot be reached right now. Try again later.
abort.exchange_changed: The gateways in the cloud access have changed. Open the repair again when it is shown again.
abort.exchange_collision: Nothing was changed: entities or a device for the new gateway already exist. Remove them first or keep the new gateway as a separate system.
abort.exchange_failed: Nothing was changed; the system continues with the old gateway. Details are in the log.
abort.unload_failed: Nothing was changed: the integration could not be stopped. Restart Home Assistant and open the repair again.

setup_unfinished.title: Setup not finished
setup_unfinished.description: The entry "{title}" has no access yet. Open its configuration options and choose "Set up local access" (or add a cloud access) to finish the setup.

invalid_stored_configuration.message: The saved configuration of this entry cannot be read ({reason}). Nothing was changed. Restore a backup from before the problem, or delete the entry and add it again.

holiday_previous_request_found.message: The earlier unresolved request is now confirmed. Your new inputs were not sent. Check the existing holiday under Configure → Manage holiday periods.

holiday_already_exists.message: A holiday with this start and circuit selection already exists. Edit that entry under Configure → Manage holiday periods.

holiday_create_unconfirmed.message: Creation could not be confirmed. The holiday may already exist. Check Manage holiday periods or the manufacturer app. For the next 10 minutes, another attempt checks the unresolved request without creating a second holiday.

holiday_update_unconfirmed.message: The change could not be fully confirmed. Some settings may already have been saved. Check the current holiday under Configure → Manage holiday periods.

holiday_write_adjusted.message: The heating system returned holiday settings that differ from your request. Check the returned dates and settings under Configure → Manage holiday periods and edit that entry.

holiday_time_step.message: Choose a quarter-hour time: minutes 00, 15, 30, or 45 and seconds 00.

holiday_time_nonexistent.message: The selected start or end time does not exist because the clock moves forward in the heating system's time zone. Choose another time.

holiday_time_ambiguous.message: The selected start or end time occurs twice because the clock moves back in the heating system's time zone. Choose an unambiguous time.

rrc_mode_locked.message: The controller currently locks the heating mode of this zone, for example while the system cools. The current mode stays shown. Try again later.

write_validation_failed.message: This setting is not currently safe to change. Refresh or reconfigure the integration and try again.

write_not_confirmed.message: The change was sent, but the heating system did not confirm it. It may already have taken effect. The value is updated with the next reading.

rrc_write_pending_confirmation.message: The change was sent to the room controller, but it has not confirmed it yet. The controller may apply it with a delay; the value is updated with the next reading.

write_authentication_failed.message: The cloud sign-in is no longer valid. Reauthenticate Bosch/Buderus Home Comfort before trying again.

write_rate_limited.message: The PointT cloud is currently limiting requests. Wait before trying the change again.

write_failed.message: The change could not be completed and was not confirmed by the heating system. The value shown is updated with the next reading.

write_busy.message: The heating system is being read or another change is still running. Nothing was sent. Try again in a moment.

holiday_end_not_after_start.message: The end must be after the start. Please choose a later end.

bacon_unsupported_command.message: The device does not currently support this setting. Check its connection, available modes and temperature limits.

bacon_command_failed.message: The change could not be confirmed by the device. I have not sent it again. Check the reported state before trying again.

bacon_separate_settings.message: Please change temperature and operation mode separately so each change can be confirmed.

heating_climate_command.message: This thermostat command is not currently available. Temperatures can only be changed in manual heating mode. Select the mode separately and check that the appliance is providing current values.

pointt_dhw_temperature_read_only.message: The appliance determines the current hot water setpoint. You can adjust the separate mode start temperatures under Operate appliance.

gateway_exchange_incomplete.message: An interrupted gateway exchange could not be finished, so the integration does not start. Details are in the log; remove what blocks the exchange (for example entities of the new gateway) and restart Home Assistant.

rrc_override_ended.message: The room controller ended the temporary setpoint at once, for example because the next switch point of the schedule was reached. The schedule's setpoint applies.

rrc_override_needs_clock_mode.message: A temporary setpoint can only be set or cleared while the zone follows its schedule. Select the schedule mode first.

rrc_override_below_minimum.message: The temporary setpoint must lie at or above the lowest manual setpoint of the zone. Choose a higher temperature.

rrc_override_not_active.message: This zone has no temporary setpoint to clear at the moment.

rrc_zone_climate_command.message: This zone command is not available at the moment. Check that the zone reports current values and that the temperature lies within the offered range; a temporary setpoint needs the schedule mode.

rrc_device_setting_unused.message: The radio device does not use this setting at the moment, so it was not changed.

rrc_window_sensitivity_level.message: Only the levels high, medium and low can be set for the open window detection.

rrc_time_of_day_invalid.message: The start time must be a time of day between 00:00 and 23:59.

rrc_curve_order.message: The heating curve and the supply limits must stay in order: the base point below the end point, the minimum supply temperature not above the maximum. Nothing was sent; change the other limit first.

rrc_event_invalid_name.message: Enter a name with 1 to 32 bytes of printable text (fewer characters with umlauts or emoji).

rrc_event_invalid_dates.message: The event needs whole days: a start on or before the end, and an end not in the past.

rrc_event_overlap.message: The event shares a day with another event of the room controller. Events may not overlap, not even on their first or last day.

rrc_event_type_read_only.message: A day run like another weekday can only be deleted here, not changed.

rrc_event_rejected.message: The room controller refused the event, for example because its calendar is full. Nothing was changed.

rrc_event_pending.message: An earlier change of the events is not confirmed yet. Nothing was sent; wait until it shows in the calendar or try again in ten minutes.

rrc_event_unsupported_fields.message: The room controller stores only a name and whole days. Recurring events, descriptions and locations are not supported.

rrc_boost_no_zones.message: The boost has no rooms. Select the rooms for the boost on the room controller first.

rrc_boost_unsupported_shape.message: The room controller reports the boost in a form this integration does not know completely. The boost is shown but not changed, so that no setting is lost.

rrc_boost_locked.message: The room controller currently locks the boost. Try again later.
